authority.proposedExpiryPolicy: All proposedExpiry values are null. No evidence establishes an approved extension or a justified completion deadline. Historical owner-accepted bridge text is preserved as provenance, not interpreted as current approval.
authority.retirementMeaning: The original seven RETIRED classifications have now been implemented by exact ledger-entry removal under the user's explicit same-task authorization. All other classifications remain proposals requiring recorded owner/governance decisions.
authority.approvalGrantedScope: approvalGranted=false means no new exception, renewal, residual-risk acceptance, or gate clearance is approved. The user separately authorized only A03, N01, N02, N04, N05, N14 and N15 for removal.

methodology.evaluation: Read-only counterfactual: evaluate each entry against the implemented rule before exception suppression. Transpile the existing TypeScript rule modules and governance-helpers with the installed TypeScript compiler in memory; use their actual walkSync, relPath, isExcepted/minimatch, isRouteFile, isExcludedPath and regex objects. Do not execute Vitest describe blocks or application modules.
methodology.sourceUniverse: walkSync(apps) extensions .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs. Skip node_modules, dist, .next, .turbo, build, coverage, .git, __fixtures__, .venv, playwright-report, test-results. Paths in JSON use the rule's normalized repository-relative slash notation.
methodology.archLayer: Only apps/*/app/api/, pages/api/, src/routes/, server/ paths; skip .test/.spec JS/TS files and __tests__. Count every matching prohibited pattern on each line, not DB operations. All server/ files are treated as routes by the actual implementation.
methodology.noConsole: Actual SCAN_ROOTS is only apps, despite the header mentioning runtime packages. Skip test/spec/__tests__, scripts, tools, tooling, seeds, config/setup files. Count the first direct console.log/info/warn/error/debug call per line. The conditional civic archived-proof CLI exemption cannot intersect any of these 22 entry globs.
limitations: These are lexical rule matches, not executed production events or a proof of tenant isolation.

ARCH_LAYER_001 includes schema imports and drizzle instantiation but misses @nzila/db/platform, @nzila/db/scoped, local @/db imports, most named repository paths, dynamic imports and multiline from clauses.
NO_CONSOLE_001 misses Reflect/bracket/alias access and console method references without a direct call. Zero matches does not establish absence of logging, approved redaction, or privacy compliance.

matchedSourceFileCount counts walked source files matching the glob; scannedFileCount additionally applies the actual rule's scope. An existing app directory is not proof that its exception is necessary.
Examples are bounded to two matching file+line locations per entry. Counts cover every current matching scanned file, without printing code snippets, credentials or runtime payload values.
No full suite, expensive suite, application execution, external service call or subagent was used.

closureCriteria: Seven explicitly authorized redundant entries are retired in the ledgers. Owners review the remaining 26 proposals and submit separate scoped changes; no new exception or renewal is approved.
Retirement candidates must pass the actual rule without their entry, not just have an existing directory.
Remediation must preserve authorization, audit, runtime error behavior and import direction; no renamed alias or reflected console access may be used to evade governance.

Structural exceptions require documented narrow module roles, explicit reviewer/approver decision, regression tests and lifecycle ownership. Browser necessity or INCUBATING status alone is insufficient.
